coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review .SRCINFO due to API error (HTTP 400), resulting in incomplete coverage
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should not force an 'inconclusive' verdict when other models have successfully reviewed the same files and reached agreement. The adjudication logic should distinguish between 'no verdict due to tool failure' and 'genuine uncertainty about safety'.

When one model has a coverage gap due to tool error but another model has full coverage and finds no issues, the full-coverage model's verdict should carry decisive weight rather than being diluted by the failed model's incomplete result.
